reason: Both answers are excellent and cover nearly identical strategic ground. Answer A gets the edge for doing the explicit burn-rate math on the 5-person team right at the beginning. Showing that a 5-person team likely burns $50k-$90k/month—meaning $400k is only 5-8 months of total company runway—frames the entire problem much more accurately than Answer B, which occasionally slips into treating the $400k as a discretionary budget (e.g., advising in the conclusion not to commit the whole $400k to either option).
